title: Exhaustive request is downgraded when a major surface is only spot-checked

modelOutput.overallVerdict: No blocking defect was proven, but release readiness depends on validation and one frontend surface was spot-checked rather than exhaustively reviewed.

discoveredSurfaces.name: Frontend presentational surfaces
discoveredSurfaces.reason: Representative files were sampled but every component was not directly reviewed.

coverageNotes: User requested exhaustive/full review, but achievedDepth is deep_audit because frontend presentational surfaces were spot-checked rather than every discovered surface being directly reviewed with evidence.

validationRun.command: bun test && bun run typecheck && bun run lint
validationRun.summary: Not run during this read-only audit; readiness depends on a later validation run or fresh CI evidence.

findings.title: Spot-checked frontend surface prevents full-audit readiness claim
findings.impact: The review can still be useful, but claiming exhaustive coverage would overstate the evidence gathered.
findings.remediation: Keep achievedDepth at deep_audit and list the spot-checked surface until every frontend file is directly reviewed.

nextSteps: Run validation or attach fresh CI evidence before release readiness claims.
Directly review the frontend presentational surface if full_audit output is required.
